kanban_no_grouping: This board has no property that cards can be grouped by.
kanban_delete_group_description: The option is removed from the {property} property. Cards that have it are shown under “{none}”.
kanban_drag_help: Press Space to pick up the card, the arrow keys to move it, Space or Enter to drop it, Escape to cancel.
kanban_drag_cancelled: Cancelled. {item} is back in {list}, position {position} of {count}.
kanban_drag_sorted: This view is sorted: choose a column, and the sort places the card.
kanban_column_help: Press Space to pick up the column, the left and right arrow keys to move it, Space or Enter to drop it, Escape to cancel.
kanban_column_picked_up: Picked up the column {item}, position {position} of {count}.
kanban_column_dropped: Dropped the column {item} at position {position} of {count}.
kanban_column_cancelled: Cancelled. The column {item} is back at position {position} of {count}.
